jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer - Advertising
jobs.description:
About Truelogic

At Truelogic we are a leading provider of nearshore staff augmentation services headquartered in New York. For over two decades, we’ve been delivering top-tier technology solutions to companies of all sizes, from innovative startups to industry leaders, helping them achieve their digital transformation goals.

Our team of 600+ highly skilled tech professionals, based in Latin America, drives digital disruption by partnering with U.S. companies on their most impactful projects. Whether collaborating with Fortune 500 giants or scaling startups, we deliver results that make a difference.

By applying for this position, you’re taking the first step in joining a dynamic team that values your expertise and aspirations. We aim to align your skills with opportunities that foster exceptional career growth and success while contributing to transformative projects that shape the future.

Our Client

Our client is a global technology and creative network that brings together engineering and creative expertise in equal measure to help businesses drive innovation, digital transformation, and long-term growth. As part of a leading global marketing and communications group, the company combines strategy, design, and technology to deliver end-to-end digital experiences and solutions. Its portfolio includes partnerships with some of the world's most recognized brands across industries such as technology, finance, media, sports, and consumer goods.

Job Summary

We are seeking a hands-on Senior Data Engineer to build scalable data infrastructure to support data-driven insights and predictive and generative AI models. The Senior Data Engineer will lead technical workstreams, contribute to defining data engineering best practices, and mentor other engineers while collaborating closely with Machine Learning Engineering teams and cross-functional stakeholders to solve complex data challenges.

Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and scale data pipelines and infrastructure for ingestion, transformation, storage, and serving

  • Collaborate with the Machine Learning Engineering team to support model training, evaluation, and serving

  • Identify opportunities to improve team processes, tooling, and ways of working

  • Contribute to thought leadership, internal knowledge sharing, and community of practice efforts

  • Translate business needs into elegant, product-minded data solutions that drive measurable business value

  • Integrate marketing data sources (GA4, advertising platforms, CRMs, CDPs) into reliable, well-modeled datasets

  • Establish data engineering standards, documentation, and monitoring practices for data quality and reliability

  • Apply AI-powered coding, agentic engineering, and AI-enabled workflows to accelerate delivery

Qualifications and Job Requirements

Must have

  • 5+ years of data engineering experience with a strong track record of ownership and impact, including building data pipelines and infrastructure from the ground up.

  • Deep expertise in cloud data platforms, with clear, well-reasoned opinions on which work best and why

  • Proficiency in Python and SQL for data processing and ETL

  • Experience building and deploying data workloads in cloud environments (AWS, GCP, or Azure)

  • Strong product orientation, with the ability to identify opportunities, prioritize initiatives, and deliver measurable business value

  • Hands-on experience with AI-powered coding, agentic engineering, and AI-enabled workflows

  • Proven experience mentoring others, establishing engineering standards, and contributing to a culture of learning

  • Familiarity with marketing data ecosystems (GA4, advertising platforms, CRMs, CDPs)

  • Solid software engineering fundamentals: version control, testing, code review, and CI/CD

  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to work with every technical level at an organization that is 50/50 tech and creative

  • Experience working in complex, ambiguous projects from definition through delivery

  • Advanced English (B2 or higher)

Nice to Have

  • Experience with data governance, privacy compliance, and security best practices

  • Experience integrating AI/ML capabilities into data pipelines, with exposure to GenAI applications

  • Familiarity with MLOps tooling (MLflow, SageMaker, Vertex AI) and vector databases or RAG patterns

  • Experience working across multiple verticals or client types

  • Track record of advocating for and implementing process improvements

What We Offer

  • 100% Remote Work: Enjoy the freedom to work from the location that helps you thrive. All it takes is a laptop and a reliable internet connection.

  • Highly Competitive USD Pay: Earn an excellent, market-leading compensation in USD, that goes beyond typical market offerings.

  • Paid Time Off: We value your well-being. Our paid time off policies ensure you have the chance to unwind and recharge when needed.

  • Work with Autonomy: Enjoy the freedom to manage your time as long as the work gets done. Focus on results, not the clock.

  • Work with Top American Companies: Grow your expertise working on innovative, high-impact projects with Industry-Leading U.S. Companies.

Why You’ll Like Working Here

  • A Culture That Values You: We prioritize well-being and work-life balance, offering engagement activities and fostering dynamic teams to ensure you thrive both personally and professionally.

  • Diverse, Global Network: Connect with over 600 professionals in 25+ countries, expand your network, and collaborate with a multicultural team from Latin America.

  • Team Up with Skilled Professionals: Join forces with senior talent. All of our team members are seasoned experts, ensuring you're working with the best in your field.

Apply now!

jobs.title: Technical Consultant
jobs.description:
We're looking for a Technical Consultant to help deliver customer data migrations and system implementations. You'll work directly with clients and internal implementation teams to convert customer data onto our platform, stand up new customer systems and work on internal technical projects - all while keeping projects on time, on budget, and running smoothly.

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Migrate customer data from legacy/source systems onto our platform, including writing and troubleshooting custom scripts where needed
  • Write and run SQL queries to extract, transform, and validate customer data
  • Stand up and configure new customer systems/environments as part of implementation
  • Migrate databases to our Azure cloud platform
  • Communicate directly with customers on requirements, timelines, and expectations
  • Work with Project Managers and Implementation teams to flag risks and keep delivery on track
  • Maintain up-to-date knowledge of our products, tools, and migration methodologies
  • Keep activity reports and project documentation up to date within agreed SLAs
  • Follow company security policies - protecting customer data and reporting any issues

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:

  • 1–3 years of relevant technical consulting or data engineering experience preferred
  • Experience writing and troubleshooting SQL (ideally Microsoft SQL Server / T-SQL - stored procedures, functions, triggers, indexes)
  • Basic knowledge of REST/SOAP APIs and tools like Postman
  • Basic knowledge of IIS
  • Comfortable communicating with customers on technical requirements
  • Bachelor's degree in IT, Computer Science, or a related field or equivalent work experience
  • Able to work independently and manage your own workload

WHAT WOULD ALSO BE AWESOME:

  • Experience with an ETL toolset (e.g. SSIS)
  • Experience with other RDBMS platforms (Oracle, MySQL, Postgres)
  • Experience with BI Tools (PowerBI, Sigma, Izenda)
  • Familiarity with EDI/integration platforms (e.g. Boomi)
  • Advanced Excel/data manipulation skills

Compensation

Please note that salary estimates provided by websites (LinkedIn, Glassdoor, etc.) and not by WorkWave may not accurately reflect the actual salary range for the position.

Additional Information

WHAT YOU SHOULD KNOW ABOUT US:

• We are laid back but buttoned up. We offer a casual work environment and remote work flexibility and have a passion for developing creative, innovative best in class solutions that directly contribute to the success of our customers

• We care deeply and deliver service and solutions that make a real difference in the lives of our clients and their businesses

• We openly accept others as they are and build strong partnerships based on trust

• Teamwork and collaboration is key to help our colleagues and customers solve their challenges

• Our team is energetic, fun, naturally inquisitive and eager to make an impact, we invite you to join us!

LOVE WHAT YOU DO, NO MATTER WHERE YOU DO IT:

• Join our Remote-First Global Work Community: WorkWave provides an innovative and dynamic remote-first Global Work Community that encourages growth, creativity, and collaboration. No matter what stage of your career or where you live, WorkWave is your place to be part of a global company with a startup feel, where your ideas matter and your growth is a priority.

A GLOBAL COMPANY WITH A LOCAL PRESENCE:

• We know that there are benefits of being in the office and working from home. WorkWave promotes a healthy work/life balance and provides employees with the flexibility of collaborating in the office or the option to work virtually if desired. Our teams are well versed at working collaboratively in a fully virtual environment.

• Our HQ is based at our state of the art home office in the historic Bell Works complex located in Holmdel Township, New Jersey. We keep our offices available to all to use when working remotely isn’t feasible, or to help with cross training, team building and/or brainstorming.

• We have employees in over 30 states, 7 countries and many regional offices - each with their own set of perks and opportunities to give back to the local community.

• Whether you work remotely or take advantage of one of our offices, you’ll find a community of WorkWavers that value diversity, and care deeply about our products, clients, our communities and each other.

RELAX, WE'VE GOT YOU COVERED:

• Employees can expect a robust benefits package, including 25 days holiday plus an additional 5 days of flexible time off

AND BEYOND...

• Comprehensive financial protection - critical illness cover, income protection, death in service cover and pension contribution

• Wellbeing benefits - Global Wellbeing Program, access to a private GP service, discounted healthcare and paid for counseling sessions

• Enhanced maternity, paternity and adoption leave and pay

• Retail discounts and technology benefits

• Paid time off for volunteering

GROW WITH US:

• Encouraging our employees that already have an intimate knowledge of and passion for our products to apply for other roles within our walls just makes sense!

JOIN OUR WINNING TEAM!

jobs.title: Senior Sales Engineer, Enterprise, German Speaking
jobs.description:
From Fivetran’s founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. With Fivetran, customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required. We’re proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data-driven.

About Us

Fivetran and dbt Labs are bringing together two industry-leading companies with a shared mission: helping organizations unlock the full value of their data.
Together, we’re delivering the data infrastructure layer that helps organizations move, transform, and trust their data — from the moment data moves, through every transformation, to the context teams and AI systems rely on.
Fivetran helps organizations automate data movement across the systems, clouds, engines, and tools they rely on. dbt Labs pioneered analytics engineering, helping teams transform data into reliable, governed insights. Together, we support thousands of organizations as they build a trusted foundation for analytics, AI, and better business decisions.
As we bring our teams and technology together, we’re building on the strengths of both companies while continuing to deliver the products and experiences our customers know and trust. It’s an exciting time to join us: we’re creating a company with the scale, talent, and technology to help more organizations put their data to work with greater speed, confidence, and impact.
During this transition period, you may see references to both Fivetran and dbt Labs throughout our recruiting process as we integrate our teams, systems, and career sites.

About the Role

Fivetran is building data pipelines to power the modern data stack for thousands of companies.

We’re looking for a talented German speaking Senior Sales Engineer to join our Enterprise sales team. As an Enterprise Sales Engineer, you will work closely with our sales team to understand our Enterprise customers’ complex business needs and showcase how Fivetran’s data replication solutions can help them achieve their desired business outcomes. You will be responsible for providing technical expertise, identifying technical requirements, and ensuring a successful proof-of value throughout the sales cycle.

This is a full-time remote position based out of Ireland.

Technologies You’ll Use

AWS, GCP, Azure, Snowflake, BigQuery, Databricks, New Relic, Linux, Windows, Python, Java

What You’ll Do

  • Work with Enterprise customers to understand their business, their use cases, and their data replication requirements
  • Develop and deliver technical presentations to Enterprise audiences
  • Ensure the technical win by running an organized proof-of-value process
  • Work closely with multiple cross-fuctional organizations driving change and improvements to Fivetran as a whole.
  • Work closely with multiple Sales representatives, while maintaining a high level of customer focus and technical excellence
  • Stay up-to-date on the latest technologies and trends in our industry
  • Assist team members in advanced technical or business roadblocks

Skills We’re Looking For

  • Native/Professional Proficiency in German
  • 5+ years in data replication, sales engineering, or related technical field
  • Strong technical background covering database replication, cloud infrastructure, and data replication technologies with some form of hands on experience
  • Experience with modern data analytics technologies, including cloud data warehouses, transformation tooling, data catalogs, and BI tools
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills with a keen ability to explain complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills
  • Experience with Oracle, SQL Server, Postgres, MySQL, and NoSQL databases
  • Hands on experience with other data replication or ETL tools
  • Experience with self-hosted software applications and supporting infrastructure
  • Hands on networking experience both in the cloud and on-premise

Bonus Skills​

  • Experience developing partner relationships
  • Specialized expertise in security posture
  • Experience with self-hosted and SaaS software applications
  • Hands on experience with DBT
  • Docker/Podman/Kubernetes experience

Demonstrated experience in channel sales, reseller programs, and GTM execution within the software or SaaS industry across EMEA

Strong business development and negotiation skills to identify, onboard, and scale strategic reseller relationships
Proven ability to collaborate cross-functionally with regional sales leadership, alliances, marketing, and deal desk across multiple countries and time zones
Self-starter mindset with a passion for building and scaling programs in a fast-paced, high-growth environment

This is a full-time position based in the United Kingdom or a major EMEA hub [London / remote].

Salesforce, Looker, Gong, Crossbeam

Develop and nurture relationships with key EMEA resell and distribution partners, aligned to shared revenue targets and joint business plans

Strong relationship-building capabilities with partner executives and field sellers alike, across diverse business cultures

Proficiency in building and delivering partner training programs
Strong analytical skills to track reseller performance, identify improvement areas, and report to senior management
Entrepreneurial spirit and comfort operating in a newly combined organization

Job Title: Senior Integrations Engineer
Location Preference: 100% remote in LATAM with preference in Chile working EST Time Zone 
Duration: 1-Year Assignment with possibility of extension

NTT DATA is a team of more than 139,000 diverse professionals operating in more than 50 countries worldwide. Our sectors of activity include telecommunications, finance, industry, utilities, energy, public administration, and health.

Our mission? Offer technological solutions, business, strategy, development, and application maintenance while being a benchmark in consulting. Thanks to the collaboration between teams, the human quality of our people, and the fact that we do not conform to what is established, we always seek innovation that brings us closer to the future.

Our essence has led us to the forefront of technology, breaking paradigms and providing solutions that truly respond to each client's needs. Our talent has led us to be one of the top six technology companies in the world.

Because #Greattech, needs #GreatPeople, like you

NTT Data seeks high-achieving team players who quickly adapt to new challenges and entrepreneurial ventures. We are looking for a Senior Integrations Engineer to work with our global client for a fully remote opportunity in LATAM working EST hours.

Position Summary

Data integration engineer specialized in designing, developing, and operating enterprise data pipelines on ETL tools; Informatica IDMC (Intelligent Data Management Cloud / IICS) as the primary platform, with strong capabilities in feeding the Databricks Lakehouse. Able to work across cloud-agnostic environments (Azure, AWS, GCP) and to apply AI-assisted development with CLAIRE GPT and CLAIRE Copilot to accelerate the build cycle and reduce time-to-delivery.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and implement ingestion, transformation, and distribution pipelines with CDI and Cloud Mass Ingestion.
  • Build and optimize ingestion and ELT into the Databricks Lakehouse using IDMC for Databricks and Delta Lake patterns.
  • Migrate PowerCenter workloads to IDMC using structured methodology and internal accelerators.
  • Operate and maintain integration infrastructure (Secure Agents, runtimes) on Azure and AWS under SLA standards.
  • Apply CLAIRE GPT/Copilot to optimize the mapping development cycle and reduce delivery time.

Requirements

Technical Skills:

  • Informatica IDMC · Integration Core

    • Cloud Data Integration (CDI): Mapping Designer, SQL ELT with pushdown optimization (full/source/target), Taskflows, mapping partitioning, Dynamic Mappings, parameterization, file listeners, intelligent structure models (CLAIRE-powered), and performance tuning.
    • Cloud Mass Ingestion (CMI): batch and near-real-time ingestion from heterogeneous sources across its variants: Mass Ingestion Databases (CDC), Files, Applications, and Streaming.
    • Cloud Application Integration (CAI): Process Designer, service connectors, guides, and business processes; API and microservices integration.
    • PowerCenter to IDMC: migration and modernization of on-premises pipelines using structured methodology, CDI-PC, and migration accelerators.
    • Platform operations: administration of Secure Agents and runtime environments (Secure Agent Groups), monitoring, and SLA management.

    Databricks Integration

    • IDMC for Databricks: ingestion and ELT into the Databricks Lakehouse with CDI and Cloud Mass Ingestion, Delta Lake load patterns, and SQL ELT pushdown to Databricks SQL.
    • Connectivity through the Databricks connector (Partner Connect), Unity Catalog awareness, and parameterized job orchestration.

    AI-Assisted Development (CLAIRE)

    • CLAIRE GPT / CLAIRE Copilot: assisted generation of mappings, debugging of transformations, and automatic pipeline documentation through natural language within IDMC.
    • Awareness of the new agentic capabilities (CLAIRE Agents, Fall 2025 release) for headless ingestion and transformation flows.

    Platform FinOps

    • Understanding of the IPU (Informatica Processing Units) consumption model and per-service cost optimization.

    Cloud-Agnostic (Complementary)

    • Azure: Azure Data Factory (ADF), Data Lake Storage Gen2, Key Vault, Azure Databricks.
    • AWS: Glue, S3, Step Functions, Redshift, Athena, EventBridge.
    • GCP (desirable): BigQuery, Cloud Composer.
    • IaC & CI/CD for pipelines: Terraform, CloudFormation; GitHub/Bitbucket, Jenkins.

    Databases & Platforms

    • Advanced SQL (Oracle, SQL Server, PostgreSQL, Redshift, Databricks SQL).
    • NoSQL (MongoDB, DynamoDB; desirable).
    • Data Warehouse, Data Lake, and Lakehouse architecture patterns.

Certifications:

  • Informatica Cloud Data Integration Developer, Professional Certification (ICP) (core to the role).
  • Informatica Cloud Application Integration Developer, Professional Certification (desirable).
  • Informatica IDMC Foundation / Data Engineering Foundation.
  • Databricks Certified Data Engineer Associate (desirable).
  • Microsoft Certified: Azure Data Engineer Associate (DP-203) (complementary).
  • AWS Certified Data Engineer / Data Analytics Specialty (complementary).

Why NTT Data?

Empowerment and rewards are the cornerstone of our career development model. We are a young, fast-growing company, with a highly innovative and entrepreneurial spirit, because of this professional experience and growth will be unmatched. Our talent and positive attitude allow us to transform our goals into achievements, and projects into realities.

NTT Data is committed to hiring and retaining a diverse workforce. We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action-Employer, making decisions without regard to race, color, religion, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, national origin, age, veteran status, disability, or any other protected class. NTT Data is an Equal Opportunity Employer Male/Female/Disabled/Veteran and a VEVRAA Federal Contractor.

jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

Samsara is seeking a Data Engineer to join our Data team, comprising both Data Scientists, Data Analysts, and Data Engineers. Our team is at the forefront of enhancing data analysis efficiency and effectiveness. Our data engineers develop and maintain data pipelines integral to our analytics data model.

As a Data Engineer, your primary responsibility will be designing and maintaining data pipelines, primarily utilizing SparkSQL and Pyspark, within our central data lake. These pipelines are crucial for ingesting and transforming source data from our IOT devices and software products into our core data model, facilitating statistical analysis, model training, and dashboard creation.

This is a remote position open to candidates residing in Canada. Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: The software, firmware, and hardware you build will result in real-world impact – helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • You are a life-long learner: We have ambitious goals. Every Samsarian has a growth mindset as we work with a wide range of technologies, challenges, and customers that push us to learn on the go.
  • You believe customers are more than a number: Samsara engineers enjoy a rare closeness to the end user and you will have the opportunity to participate in customer interviews, collaborate with customer success and product managers, and use metrics to ensure our work is translating into better customer outcomes.
  • You are a team player: Working on our Samsara Engineering teams requires a mix of independent effort and collaboration. Motivated by our mission, we’re all racing toward our connected operations vision, and we intend to win – together.

In this role, you will:

  • Build and maintain highly reliable computed tables, incorporating data from various sources, including unstructured data like video and audio, Samsara sensor & product data, and customer metadata.
  • Access, manipulate, and integrate external datasets with internal data.
  • Deliver high-quality data with strong uptime and reliability requirements, including customer-facing data sets.
  • Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams such as Data Science & Analytics, AI/ML, and other Data Engineers to ensure high-quality data for diverse purposes from causal inference, model training, and dashboarding.
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices.

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • BA / MS degree in Computer Science, Statistics, or a related discipline.
  • 4+ years experience in a data engineering-focused role.
  • Demonstrated experience in designing data models at scale.
  • Proficiency in building ETL pipelines to handle large volumes of data.
  • Experience with Spark-based data platforms.
  • Strong command of at least one data orchestration tool (e.g Airflow, Dagster, or Prefect).
  • Expertise in SQL, Python, and working with REST APIs.
  • Familiarity with software engineering fundamentals and reading backend development code.
  • Experience with version control systems such as Git/GitHub.

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Familiarity with time series data and late-arriving data.
  • Knowledge of Databricks, Delta Lakes, and Dagster.
  • Previous experience working in a public cloud (e.g AWS, GCP, Azure).
  • Exposure working on a data model for a product’s first-party data.
  • Exposure to complex data, including ML outputs and/or client-side signals.

The compensation range shown spans approved pay zones for this role. Your primary work location determines the range applicable to you, which may be narrower than the full range displayed.

The range of annual base salary for full-time employees for this position is below. Please note that base pay offered may vary depending on factors including your city of residence, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. This role is also eligible for an initial RSU grant with no vesting cliff, and ongoing refresh opportunities tied to performance, subject to plan terms and conditions. Learn more about our total rewards and benefits below.

Annual Base Salary

$110,500—$143,000 CAD

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email accessibleinterviewing@samsara.com or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us-greenhouse-mail.io or @mail3.guide.co. For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

jobs.title: Director of Platform Engineering [gn] – Data Intelligence Platform
jobs.description:
About Actian

Actian is the company behind the Data Intelligence Platform — an enterprise solution that helps organisations discover, govern, and trust their data at scale.

Our platform connects metadata, data lineage, data quality, and business context into a single knowledge graph, enabling enterprises to turn raw data into reliable decisions and providing the trusted data foundation required for enterprise AI.

We operate globally, move fast, and build for the long term.

The Opportunity

We are looking for an experienced Director of Platform Engineering or Director of DevOps to establish and lead our newly formed Platform Engineering organisation.

This is a hands-on technical leadership position for an engineering leader who has successfully built and scaled platform or infrastructure teams within a technology product company.

You will not simply inherit and manage an existing organisation. You will build the team, define its technical direction, establish its operating model, and remain closely involved in architecture and implementation.

You should be someone who can move confidently between strategic decisions and hands-on engineering: designing infrastructure, reviewing code, implementing automation, solving complex production challenges, and setting engineering standards.

We are an AI-first engineering organisation. We expect you to actively use AI technologies to accelerate engineering, automate infrastructure operations, and fundamentally rethink how platform teams work.

This is a builder's role, not a traditional executive management position.

What You Will Own:

1. Platform Engineering & Architecture

  • Establish and lead the Platform Engineering organisation from the ground up.
  • Design and implement scalable, reliable platform services supporting our data catalog, knowledge graph, and integration APIs.
  • Define the architecture and engineering standards used across the organisation.
  • Establish clear ownership boundaries and effective collaboration with product engineering teams.

2. Cloud Infrastructure & Deployment

  • Design and deliver a cloud-agnostic deployment architecture across AWS, Azure or Google Cloud, and customer-managed on-premises and private-cloud environments.
  • Build and maintain Kubernetes-based infrastructure in production.
  • Own infrastructure as code using Terraform/Terragrunt and GitOps-based deployment using Argo CD or equivalent technologies.
  • Ensure reliable installation, upgrades, maintenance, and supportability across different customer environments.
  • Support restricted-network and air-gapped deployment scenarios where required.

3. AI-First Engineering & Infrastructure Operations

  • Integrate AI agents into infrastructure operations, including incident triage, remediation, change validation, and reporting.
  • Use AI coding assistants and development agents extensively in your own daily engineering work.
  • Establish practical standards for AI-assisted engineering across the platform team.
  • Identify opportunities to replace traditional tools and operational processes with AI-driven automation.
  • Build the infrastructure required to support AI and ML workloads, including model-serving environments and associated data services.
  • Ensure appropriate human oversight, security guardrails, and auditability for AI-driven operations.

4. Security, Compliance & Reliability

  • Establish security and compliance practices supporting SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, and GDPR.
  • Ensure compliance with EU data residency and customer-specific security requirements.
  • Implement automated compliance evidence collection and audit readiness.
  • Establish observability, monitoring, incident management, and on-call practices.

5. Team Building & Leadership

  • Recruit, develop, and lead a high-performing Platform Engineering team.
  • Define the team's structure, responsibilities, processes, and engineering culture.
  • Remain technically involved while developing the team's capabilities and autonomy.
  • Work closely with the SVP of Engineering and other technical leaders to align platform strategy with business and product priorities.

What You Will Deliver in Your First 12 Months:

  • Build and establish a high-performing Platform Engineering team with clear ownership and responsibilities.
  • Deliver a portable deployment architecture supporting AWS, at least one additional public cloud, and customer-managed infrastructure.
  • Establish infrastructure as code and GitOps delivery as standard engineering practices.
  • Introduce AI agents into operational workflows, with measurable reductions in manual effort and operational overhead.
  • Deliver scalable infrastructure foundations for our data catalog, knowledge graph, and integration APIs.
  • Automate compliance evidence collection and improve audit readiness.
  • Establish a reliable operating model covering observability, incident response, security, and cloud cost management.

What You Bring:

Leadership & Experience

  • 10+ years of professional experience in Platform Engineering, DevOps, Infrastructure Engineering, or SRE.
  • At least 3 years of direct engineering management experience.
  • Currently operating at Director of Platform Engineering, Director of DevOps, or an equivalent hands-on Director-level position.
  • Demonstrated experience building and scaling engineering teams, rather than exclusively managing established organisations.
  • A strong track record of delivering and operating production platforms within a technology product company.
  • The ability to combine technical leadership with hands-on engineering execution.

Technical Expertise

  • Deep, hands-on production experience with Kubernetes.
  • Strong infrastructure-as-code experience, particularly Terraform or Terragrunt.
  • Proven experience implementing GitOps and CI/CD pipelines using Argo CD or comparable technologies.
  • Strong AWS expertise and practical experience designing cloud-portable architectures.
  • Experience with Azure or Google Cloud is highly desirable.
  • Demonstrated experience with self-hosted or on-premises enterprise software deployments.
  • Practical experience with SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, and data residency requirements.
  • Experience with cloud cost optimisation, FinOps, and infrastructure efficiency.

AI-First Mindset

  • Extensive practical use of AI coding assistants, development agents, and AI-driven automation.
  • Experience applying AI to engineering productivity and infrastructure operations.
  • Ability to identify, implement, and govern AI-driven operational workflows.
  • A forward-looking mindset about how AI will change platform engineering and infrastructure management.

Leadership Approach

  • Strong ownership and execution skills.
  • Comfortable making technical decisions and taking responsibility for their outcomes.
  • Able to build teams and systems from scratch.
  • Clear communication and the ability to work across distributed international engineering teams.
  • Comfortable working across US Eastern and Central European time zones.

Nice to Have:

  • Experience with enterprise data platforms, data catalogues, metadata management, or graph databases.
  • Production experience across multiple cloud providers.
  • Experience with air-gapped and restricted-network deployments.
  • Infrastructure for AI/ML workloads, model serving, vector databases, or graph data stores.
  • OpenTelemetry or comparable observability technologies.
  • Privileged access management solutions such as StrongDM.

How You Will Work:

You will report directly to the SVP of Engineering and work closely with Product Engineering, Security, Customer Success, and Support.

This is a fully remote position based in the US East Coast, UK, Germany, France, or Spain, subject to local employment eligibility.

You should be able to maintain at least four hours of daily overlap with both US Eastern Time and Central European Time.

Occasional travel for team offsites and company-wide meetings may be required.

We value builders over theorists, ownership over hierarchy, and measurable outcomes over activity.

If you have built and scaled a platform engineering organisation, remain technically hands-on, and believe AI should fundamentally change how infrastructure teams operate, we would like to hear from you.

What We Offer:

  • The chance to be part of an innovative, fast-growing company making a significant impact in the data management space.
  • Collaboration with a passionate and diverse team.
  • Competitive salary and benefits package.
  • Flexible work arrangements (remote or hybrid).
  • Opportunities for professional growth and development.

Compensation

Additional Information

Why Join Us? At Actian, we are passionate about innovation and teamwork. This role is perfect for someone who thrives in a dynamic environment, loves creating an efficient and welcoming workspace, and enjoys working closely with a talented team.

Interested? We’d love to hear from you! Let’s discuss how you can contribute to our success while growing your career with us.

We value diversity at our company. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or any other applicable legally protected characteristics in the location in which the candidate is applying.

Join the company that’s building the telemetry infrastructure for the AI era. At Cribl, we partner with IT and Security teams at many of the world’s biggest enterprises, including half of the Fortune 100, to bridge the gap between AI ambition and infrastructure reality. As the AI Platform for Telemetry, we give customers the choice, control, and flexibility to manage and analyze telemetry for both humans and agents, so they can build what’s next.

We’re one of the fastest‑growing private companies and a leading player in a massive, fast‑moving market. With a global workforce, we’re remote‑first and grounded in a simple idea: software is a people business. Cribl is the place where curious, collaborative people can do their best work, grow fast, and bring their full selves to the herd.

Why You’ll Love This Role

In addition to a competitive salary, Cribl also offers a generous benefits package which includes health, dental, vision, short-term disability, and life insurance, paid holidays and paid time off, a fertility treatment benefit, 401(k), and equity.

Base Salary Range

$116,000—$181,000 USD

Bring Your Whole Self

Diversity drives innovation, enables better decisions to support our customers, and inspires change for the better. We’re building a culture where differences are valued and welcomed, and we work together to bring out the best in each other. jobs.title: Director Cloud Architecture & Delivery
jobs.description:
About Energy Exemplar

In an era where the world is rapidly advancing towards a cleaner future through decarbonization, Energy Exemplar’s mission lies in ‘Empowering Transformative Energy Decisions’. Founded in 1999 in Adelaide, Australia, our award-winning software portfolio encompassing the modeling and simulation platform PLEXOS®, Aurora, and Adapt2, is trusted by innovative organizations across the globe. Through our technology and people, we strive to enable stakeholders from across the entire energy value chain to revolutionize the energy ecosystem and to collaboratively plan and execute for a sustainable energy future with unprecedented clarity, speed, and innovation.

Our impact is global and is being recognized across the industry. Some of our recent accolades include:

  • SaaS Company of the Year (2025) – Global Business Tech Awards.
  • Environmental Impact Award (2025) – E+E Leaders Awards.
  • IPPAI (Independent Power Producers Association of India) Power Awards (2025) - Winners
  • Finalist: Platts Global Energy Awards (2024) – Grid Edge category
  • Finalist: Reuters Global Energy Transition Awards (2024) – Technologies of Change
  • Top 50 Marketing Team (2024) – Voted by the public at the ICON Awards.

How We Work

Energy Exemplar is growing fast and that growth is driven by how we work. We trust our team to deliver great results from wherever they work best, whether that’s at home, in the office, or on the move.

We’re a global team that values ownership, integrity, and innovation. You’ll be supported to balance work and life in a way that works for you, and empowered to take initiative, solve problems, and make an impact, regardless of your background, location, or role.

Our four core values, Customer Success, One Global Team, Integrity & Ownership, and Innovation Excellence aren’t just words. They show up in how we collaborate, how we solve, and how we grow together.

About the Position

The Director of Cloud Architecture & Delivery builds and leads the cloud architecture and forward-deployed engineering capability that enables Energy Exemplar's Solutions (pre-sales) organization to win and launch cloud-hosted and AI-enabled customers. This role builds and leads a team that works directly with customers to design, integrate, deploy, and validate cloud solutions and AI agents in customer environments. The position sits at the intersection of four disciplines: enterprise cloud architecture (Azure-first, multi-cloud fluent), energy-market software (PLEXOS, Aurora, Adapt2, and the PLEXOS Intelligence layer), applied AI and agentic systems, and consultative pre-sales. Utilities, ISOs/RTOs, developers, and regulators look to the Director for how Energy Exemplar's platform and AI agents run securely and at scale alongside their own cloud estates. The role owns the technical cloud and AI deployment in every pursuit: reference architectures, security and compliance responses, proof-of-concept environments, and the delivery plan that turns commitments made during the sales process into a practical, successful cloud and AI onboarding.

The Director reports to the Vice President, Solutions (Americas) and sits within the Presales Solutions team. Partnering with Sales, Solutions, and Services, the Director shapes solutions for complex opportunities, leads technical conversations with senior customer stakeholders, and builds confidence in proposed architectures. The role works day to day with Sales and Account Directors, Solutions Engineers, Product and Engineering (PLEXOS Cloud and PLEXOS Intelligence), Post Sales Services, Customer Success, Information Security, and cloud platform partners to establish repeatable approaches to technical discovery, solution design, and validation, guide cloud migration and deployment planning, ensure a clear, practical handover into post-sales delivery, and build internal architectural expertise through coaching, enablement, and technical standards. It is a remote, United States-based Director-level position, a people-leader role that still expects individual-contributor depth, with travel of up to 30% for onsite customer meetings, executive briefings, and industry events across North America and LATAM.

Key Responsibilities

  • Build and lead a forward-deployed engineering capability that works closely with customer technical and business teams to translate priority use cases into deployed solutions.
  • Embed with customer teams, on site and in their cloud tenants, to design, integrate, and deploy AI agents and agentic workflows built on PLEXOS Intelligence, including integration with customer data, enterprise systems, APIs, and Energy Exemplar products.
  • Act as the senior cloud and AI technical advisor to customers and prospects (utilities, ISOs/RTOs, IPPs, and consultancies), engaging CIOs, CTOs, CISOs, enterprise architects, and IT leaders to build confidence and resolve technical objections.
  • Partner with Sales and Pre Sales on technical deal strategy, architecture workshops, and demonstrations; scope and guide proofs of concept and pilots with clear success criteria, from environment build and data onboarding through executive readout.
  • Define acceptance criteria with customers and validate deployed agents and solutions against the agreed success criteria (accuracy, performance, security, and human-in-the-loop controls), with evidence customers can take to their governance and risk teams.
  • Own the cloud reference architectures for PLEXOS Cloud, PLEXOS Intelligence, and adjacent AI agents and products as deployed for customers: landing zones, identity and access, networking, data residency, high-performance compute for large nodal and stochastic runs, and cost models.
  • Lead the pre-sales-to-Services handoff for cloud and AI deals: deployment plan, architecture decision record, risk register, and onboarding timeline agreed with Post Sales Services before contract signature. Develop migration roadmaps and delivery estimates with Services and Engineering, documenting assumptions, risks, and responsibilities before commitments are made, and provide architecture oversight for complex implementations so the proposed solution carries through to delivery.
  • Set guardrails for agentic deployments in regulated environments: agent identity and permissions, tool-use boundaries, evaluation harnesses, observability, and audit trails.
  • Lead cloud and AI architecture input into RFIs, RFPs, security reviews, vendor risk assessments, and proposals, coordinating specialist input and ensuring responses are accurate and achievable; lead customer discussions on SOC 2, ISO 27001, NERC CIP adjacency, FedRAMP-equivalent expectations, and CEII handling, and maintain a current response library with Information Security.
  • Establish reusable discovery frameworks, technical materials, agent templates, and deployment patterns (SaaS, customer-tenant, hybrid), including integration with customer data platforms (Databricks, Snowflake, Fabric, on-prem SQL) and API/automation patterns for model orchestration, plus runbooks and environment-as-code templates that make repeatable launches the default.
  • Partner with Product Engineering to turn repeatable customer implementation patterns into supported product capabilities, reusable integrations, and deployment assets.

Skills and Experience

  • 12+ years in enterprise technology, including 7+ years designing and delivering production cloud architectures for enterprise or regulated customers in large or mid-sized organizations.
  • Experience leading engineers embedded in customer implementations (forward-deployed, field engineering, or customer-embedded delivery teams), taking AI and data solutions from use case to production while managing customer expectations, scope, and handover.
  • Strong customer-facing pre-sales experience supporting complex enterprise software opportunities, including technical discovery, solution validation and RFI or RFP responses.
  • Deep expertise in at least one hyperscaler (Azure preferred) and working fluency across AWS and GCP: compute (VMs, Kubernetes, batch/HPC), storage, networking, identity (Entra ID, SSO/SAML/OIDC, SCIM), and managed data services.
  • Experience designing AI agent engineering in production, including LLM application and agent orchestration frameworks, retrieval and tool integration, evaluation and monitoring, and model governance.
  • Ability to connect architecture decisions to customer business objectives, commercial value and delivery feasibility, including cost and risk considerations.
  • Strong understanding of enterprise integrations, REST/GraphQL, APIs and data flows, alongside cloud performance, scalability, governance and cost optimization.
  • Executive presence, communication and the ability to lead architecture and risk conversations with CIOs, CISOs, enterprise architects, and procurement at utilities, ISOs/RTOs, and developers.
  • A Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer or Electrical Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical field.

Desirable Experience

  • Master's degree in a technical or business discipline (MS, MEng, MBA) or equivalent demonstrated senior-level experience.
  • Current professional-level cloud architecture certification: Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert, AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Professional, or Google Professional Cloud Architect.
  • Working knowledge of the North American power sector: ISO/RTO market structures (PJM, MISO, ERCOT, CAISO, SPP, NYISO, ISO-NE), utility IRP and transmission planning cycles, and the data-governance expectations that come with CEII and market-sensitive data.

As the EMEA Resell Partner Development Manager, you will own the growth of our reseller, VAR, and distribution ecosystem across the region, spanning UK&I, DACH, France, Benelux, the Nordics, Southern Europe, and the Middle East and Africa. You will manage and expand relationships with existing resell partners, recruit and onboard new strategic partners, and drive partner-sourced and partner-fulfilled revenue. Your focus will be enablement, joint pipeline generation, and establishing Fivetran as the leading platform for modern data integration and transformation.
We are seeking a highly motivated, experienced channel leader with a proven track record of building and scaling resell and VAR partnerships across multiple EMEA markets, including pan-European solution providers, regional specialists, distributors, cloud marketplaces, and public sector frameworks.

Key qualifications include:
Demonstrated experience in channel sales, reseller programs, and GTM execution within the software or SaaS industry across EMEA
Established relationships with pan-European and regional solution providers (for example SoftwareOne, Softcat, Computacenter, Bechtle, Insight, Atea, Bytes) and familiarity with how their sales organizations, incentives, and procurement processes operate
Experience working with distributors such as Ingram Micro, TD SYNNEX, Arrow, or ALSO, and an understanding of two-tier channel models
Working knowledge of cloud marketplace transactions, including AWS Channel Partner Private Offers (CPPO), Microsoft Azure Multiparty Private Offers, and Google Cloud Marketplace
Understanding of EMEA public sector procurement, including frameworks such as UK G-Cloud and Crown Commercial Service and EU tender processes, is a strong plus
Familiarity with EMEA data regulation and sovereignty considerations, including GDPR, and how they shape customer buying decisions
Deep understanding of the data integration and cloud ecosystem, with the ability to articulate Fivetran’s value proposition
Strong business development and negotiation skills to identify, onboard, and scale strategic reseller relationships
Proven ability to collaborate cross-functionally with regional sales leadership, alliances, marketing, and deal desk across multiple countries and time zones
Self-starter mindset with a passion for building and scaling programs in a fast-paced, high-growth environment
Fluency in English is required; proficiency in German, French, Dutch, or a Nordic language is a strong plus
This is a full-time position based in the United Kingdom or a major EMEA hub [London / remote].

Technologies You’ll Use
Salesforce, Looker, Gong, Crossbeam

What You’ll Do
Develop and nurture relationships with key EMEA resell and distribution partners, aligned to shared revenue targets and joint business plans
Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned partners, ensuring alignment with Fivetran’s EMEA sub-regional sales teams on joint go-to-market strategy
Build joint business plans with partners that include pipeline goals, incentive programs, enablement milestones, and demand generation campaigns
Drive net-new pipeline through partner sales teams, including targeted programs for the Commercial and Mid-Market segments
Identify and recruit new resell partners aligned to Fivetran’s EMEA target markets, with attention to coverage gaps by country and sub-region
Guide partners through marketplace and private offer transactions in coordination with Deal Desk and Partner Operations
Partner with Partner Enablement and Partner Marketing to take resellers from onboarding to selling, including value proposition, use cases, and quote-to-cash processes
Conduct regular partner trainings, QBRs, and workshops to drive engagement and knowledge retention
Track partner performance, pipeline, and attainment, and provide actionable insights to EMEA and Global Channel leadership
Represent partner capabilities to Fivetran sales teams to drive co-sell alignment and rules of engagement
Achieve or exceed assigned EMEA resell bookings targets

Skills We’re Looking For
Strong relationship-building capabilities with partner executives and field sellers alike, across diverse business cultures
Sales acumen and negotiation skills to manage pricing, margins, and agreement terms that drive mutually beneficial growth

Experience with cloud data platforms such as AWS, Google Cloud, Azure, Snowflake, Databricks, or BigQuery
